GOODALE, In the Clerk's Office of the District Court of the District of Maine. Press of Stevens & Sayward, Augusta, Maine. It has been his aim to supply this want.

arxiv-2102-04546.title: Superfast Coloring in CONGEST via Efficient Color Sampling
arxiv-2102-04546.creator: Magnús M. Halldórsson, Alexandre Nolin
arxiv-2102-04546.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Magnús M. Halldórsson, Alexandre Nolin. We present a procedure for efficiently sampling colors in the 𝖢𝖮𝖭𝖦𝖤𝖲𝖳 \mathsf{CONGEST} model. It allows nodes whose number of colors exceeds their number of neighbors by a constant fraction to sample up to Θ ⁡ ( log ⁡ n ) \Theta(\log n) semi-random colors unused by their neighbors in O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) rounds, even in the distance-2 setting.

arxiv-2201-11830.title: Mean-Field Game and Reinforcement Learning MEC Resource Provisioning for SFC
arxiv-2201-11830.creator: Amine Abouaomar 1 3 , Soumaya Cherkaoui 1 , Zoubeir Mlika 1 , and Abdellatif Kobbane 3
arxiv-2201-11830.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Amine Abouaomar 1 3 , Soumaya Cherkaoui 1 , Zoubeir Mlika 1 , and Abdellatif Kobbane 3. In this paper, we address the resource provisioning problem for service function chaining (SFC) in terms of the placement and chaining of virtual network functions (VNFs) within a multi-access edge computing (MEC) infrastructure to reduce service delay. We consider the VNFs as the main entities of the system and propose a mean-field game (MFG) framework to model their behavior for their placement and chaining.

arxiv-2208-04037.title: A study of the quasi-probability distributions of the Tavis-Cummings model under different quantum channels
arxiv-2208-04037.creator: Devvrat Tiwari, Subhashish Banerjee
arxiv-2208-04037.description: Abstract We study the dynamics of the spin and cavity field of the Tavis-Cummings model using quasi-probability distribution functions and the second-order coherence function, respectively. The effects of (non)-Markovian noise are considered. The relationship between the evolution of the cavity photon number and spin excitation under different quantum channels is observed.

arxiv-2402-00381.title: A Joint Communication and Computation Framework for Digital Twin over Wireless Networks
arxiv-2402-00381.creator: Zhaohui Yang, Mingzhe Chen, Yuchen Liu, Zhaoyang Zhang
arxiv-2402-00381.description: Abstract In this paper, the problem of low-latency communication and computation resource allocation for digital twin (DT) over wireless networks is investigated. In the considered model, multiple physical devices in the physical network (PN) needs to frequently offload the computation task related data to the digital network twin (DNT), which is generated and controlled by the central server.

arxiv-2403-07060.title: Scrutinising evidence for the triggering of Active Galactic Nuclei in the outskirts of massive galaxy clusters at z ≈ 1 z\approx 1 2022 Scrutinising evidence for the triggering of Active Galactic Nuclei in the outskirts of massive galaxy clusters at z ≈ 1 z\approx 1 – References
arxiv-2403-07060.creator: Iván Muñoz Rodríguez, Antonis Georgakakis, Francesco Shankar, Ángel Ruiz, Silvia Bonoli Johan Comparat, Elias Koulouridis, Andrea Lapi, Cristina Ramos Almeida
arxiv-2403-07060.description: Abstract Environmental effects are believed to play an important yet poorly understood role in triggering accretion events onto the supermassive black holes (SMBHs) of galaxies (Active Galactic Nuclei; AGN). Massive clusters, which represent the densest structures in the Universe, provide an excellent laboratory to isolate environmental effects and study their impact on black hole growth.

arxiv-2502-16044.title: A Multi-Scale Isolation Forest Approach for Real-Time Detection and Filtering of FGSM Adversarial Attacks in Video Streams of Autonomous Vehicles
arxiv-2502-16044.creator: Richard Abhulimhen, Negash Begashaw, Gurcan Comert, Chunheng Zhao, Pierluigi Pisu
arxiv-2502-16044.description: Abstract Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have demonstrated remarkable success across a wide range of tasks, particularly in fields such as image classification. However, DNNs are highly susceptible to adversarial attacks, where subtle perturbations are introduced to input images, leading to erroneous model outputs.

arxiv-2503-14223.title: Modeling Epidemics with Memory Effects: an
arxiv-2503-14223.creator: Open Quantum System Approach
arxiv-2503-14223.description: Abstract In this work, we introduce a quantum-inspired epidemic model to study the dynamics of an infectious disease in a population divided into compartments. By treating the healthy population as a large reservoir, we construct a framework based on open quantum systems and a Hilbert space formalism to model the spread of the infection.

arxiv-2506-19391.title: Generate the Forest before the Trees - A Hierarchical Diffusion model for Climate Downscaling
arxiv-2506-19391.creator: Declan J. Curran, Sanaa Hobeichi, Hira Saleem, Hao Xue, Flora D. Salim
arxiv-2506-19391.description: Abstract Downscaling is essential for generating the high-resolution climate data needed for local planning, but traditional methods remain computationally demanding. Recent years have seen impressive results from AI downscaling models, particularly diffusion models, which have attracted attention due to their ability to generate ensembles and overcome the smoothing problem common in other AI methods.

arxiv-2506-22393.title: Multi-View Contrastive Learning for Robust Domain Adaptation in Medical Time Series Analysis Thanks: Corresponding Author
arxiv-2506-22393.creator: YongKyung Oh, Alex A. T. Bui
arxiv-2506-22393.description: Abstract Adapting machine learning models to medical time series across different domains remains a challenge due to complex temporal dependencies and dynamic distribution shifts. Current approaches often focus on isolated feature representations, limiting their ability to fully capture the intricate temporal dynamics necessary for robust domain adaptation.

arxiv-2509-15046.title: Pinch-off dynamics for a Newtonian liquid thread draining in a viscoplastic medium
arxiv-2509-15046.creator: Shu Yang 1,2 , Konstantinos Zinelis 3 , Sourojeet Chakraborty 4 , and C. Ricardo Constante-Amores 1
arxiv-2509-15046.description: Abstract The pinch-off dynamics of a Newtonian liquid thread embedded in a viscoplastic medium is investigated using direct numerical simulations and theory. Thread breakup occurs below a nearly universal threshold set by the balance of capillary and yield stresses, largely independent of the viscosity ratio at low Ohnesorge numbers.

britannica-1911-manures-and-manuring.title: Manures and Manuring (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-manures-and-manuring.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-manures-and-manuring.description: Article 'Manures and Manuring' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 17), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. meant that which was “worked by hand” (Fr. manœuvre), but gradually came to apply to any process by which the soil could be improved. Prominent among such processes was that of directly applying “manure” to the land, manure in this sense being what we now call “farmyard manure” or “dung,” the excreta of farm animals mixed with straw or other litter.

pmc-10580270.title: Patchy and Pink: Dynamics of a Chlainomonas sp. (Chlamydomonadales, chlorophyta) algal bloom on Bagley Lake, North Cascades, WA
pmc-10580270.creator: Dan van Hees, Clare Hanneman, Sophie Paradis, A G Camara, Maya Matsumoto, Trinity Hamilton, Stacy A Krueger-Hadfield, Robin B Kodner
pmc-10580270.description: Snow algal blooms frequently occur throughout alpine and polar environments during spring and summer months; however, our understanding of bloom dynamics is limited. We tracked a recurrent bloom of Chlainomonas sp. on Upper Bagley Lake in the North Cascade Mountains, USA, to assess the spatiotemporal dynamics in bloom color intensity, community photophysiology, and community composition over eight weeks.

pmc-10709936.title: Follicular fluid C3a-peptide promotes oocyte maturation through F-actin aggregation
pmc-10709936.creator: Ye Yang, Chun Zhao, Beili Chen, Xiaoning Yu, Yuxi Zhou, Danyu Ni, Xiaolan Zhang, Junqiang Zhang, Xiufeng Ling, Zhiguo Zhang, Ran Huo
pmc-10709936.description: BackgroundImmature cumulus-oocyte complexes are retrieved to obtain mature oocytes by in vitro maturation (IVM), a laboratory tool in reproductive medicine to obtain mature oocytes. Unfortunately, the efficiency of IVM is not satisfactory. To circumvent this problem, we therefore intended to commence with the composition of ovarian follicular fluid (FF), an important microenvironment influencing oocyte growth.

pmc-10726485.title: Modbed track: Visualization of modified bases in single-molecule sequencing
pmc-10726485.creator: Daofeng Li, Xiaoyu Zhuo, Jessica K. Harrison, Shane Liu, Ting Wang
pmc-10726485.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). SummaryRecent advances in long-read sequencing technologies have not only dramatically increased sequencing read length but also have improved the accuracy of detecting chemical modifications to the canonical nucleotide bases, thus opening exciting venues to investigate the epigenome. Currently, the ability to visualize modified bases from long-read sequencing data in genome browsers is still limited, preventing users from easily and fully exploring these type of data.

pmc-11405284.title: Jumonji histone demethylases are therapeutic targets in small cell lung cancer
pmc-11405284.creator: Aiden Nguyen, Clarissa G Nuñez, Tram Anh Tran, Luc Girard, Michael Peyton, Rodrigo Catalan, Cristina Guerena, Kimberley Avila, Benjamin J Drapkin, Raghav Chandra, John D Minna, Elisabeth D Martinez
pmc-11405284.description: Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) is a recalcitrant cancer of neuroendocrine (NE) origin. Changes in therapeutic approaches against SCLC have been lacking over the decades. Here, we use preclinical models to identify a new therapeutic vulnerability in SCLC consisting of the targetable Jumonji lysine demethylase (KDM) family.

pmc-12732608.title: Synthesis and Evaluation of Novel 2-((1H-1,2,4-triazol-5-yl)thio)-N-benzylidene-N-phenylacetohydrazide as Potential Antimicrobial Agents
pmc-12732608.creator: Athul S, Bhuvaneshwari S V, Avani Anu G, Parvathi Mohanan P C, Anu R Melge, Aravind Madhavan, Bipin G Nair, Geetha Kumar, Vipin A Nair, Pradeesh Babu, Joana L C Sousa, Artur M S Silva
pmc-12732608.description: This study details the design, synthesis, and evaluation of a novel series of fourteen 2-((1H-1,2,4-triazol-5-yl)thio)-N-benzylidene-N-arylacetohydrazide hybrid compounds. The primary objective was to investigate their potential as antimicrobial agents and assess their cytotoxicity. A systematic approach combining in silico screening and experimental validation was employed. The initial in silico analysis, using SwissADME, identified compounds with favorable drug-like properties.

pmc-12750671.title: Early initiation of SGLT2 inhibitors within guideline-directed medical therapy and outcomes in newly diagnosed heart failure patients
pmc-12750671.creator: Alberto Esteban-Fernández, Silvia López-Fernández, Francisco J. Pastor-Pérez, José Ángel Pérez-Rivera, Juan Luis Bonilla-Palomas, Marta Cobo-Marcos, José Manuel García-Pinilla, Luis Almenar-Bonet, Paula Fluviá-Brugués, Francisco J. Bermúdez-Jiménez, Cristina Goena-Vives, Andrea López-López, Inés Góm
pmc-12750671.description: IntroductionHeart failure (HF) is a major cause of hospitalization and mortality. Early initiation of guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) improves outcomes in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF). This study assesses the impact of starting GDMT with an SGLT2i in newly diagnosed HFrEF patients.

pmc-13287123.title: Emerging role of mitoNEET as mitochondrial sensor of hypoxia
pmc-13287123.creator: Nghi Thao Hoang, Kourosh Honarmand Ebrahimi
pmc-13287123.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Mitochondria are organelles whose function and dynamics, that is fission, fusion, transport and selective removal (mitophagy), are fundamental for eukaryotic cells. Their dysfunction is associated with age-related neurodegeneration and the aging immune system. MitoNEET, an iron-sulfur (Fe-S) cluster-containing protein localised at the outer membrane of mitochondria, has emerged as a key regulator of mitochondrial respiration and linked to fission, fusion, and mitophagy.

pmc-13385023.title: RERAS: does age define recovery? The role of patient characteristics and ERAS protocols in robotic colorectal surgery
pmc-13385023.creator: Mohamad El-Ahmar, S Abdelhadi, F Peters, C Reissfelder, S Hetjens, B Mazul, A Armbruster, F Spans, M Dietrich, M Green, S Ulmer, M Ristig, J-P Ritz, M Karg
pmc-13385023.description: Age is frequently considered a major determinant of postoperative recovery after colorectal surgery and is often perceived as a limiting factor for an enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS®) pathway. The integration of ERAS® with a robotic surgical approach (RERAS-concept) may be associated with synergistic effects especially for this group of patients.

pmc-13435793.title: Contribution of pharmacist intervention to postoperative nausea and vomiting prophylaxis in routine multidisciplinary practice: a retrospective observational study
pmc-13435793.creator: Kotaro Sato, Shinya Suzuki, Takuma Koinuma, Akinori Omata, Emiko Iguchi
pmc-13435793.description: BackgroundPostoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV) is a common surgical complication that delays recovery and increases healthcare costs. Although U.S. guidelines recommend multimodal, risk-stratified prophylaxis, Japan lacks unified national guidelines, resulting in practice variation. Despite expanded insurance coverage for 5-HT₃ receptor antagonists, sustained adherence to best practices requires a multidisciplinary framework.
